eligibility.summary: Eligible applicants are federally recognized Indian tribes (or consortia of tribes), tribal organizations, and urban Indian organizations, as defined by section 4 of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act, Public Law 94-437. "Indian tribe" means any Indian tribe, band, nation, or other organized group or community, including any Alaska Na In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Opportunity Number: HHS-2027-ACF-ECD-TH-0003 — Agency: Administration for Children and Families.
Forecasted Opportunity: This is an advance forecast notice. Official application packages and final closing dates will be released upon posting.
Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity HHS-2027-ACF-ECD-TH-0003.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
